They aren't talking about total energy created. They're talking about increasing energy profit (energy returned on energy invested). We're getting more efficient at making the panels and researching better materials to make the panels out of. Ultimately, there is going to be a limit on how efficiently we can create the panels, at which point the the increase in energy profit is going to plateau. We're talking about the delta in energy profit from one iteration of panel design to the next. Not the energy profit of the panels themselves. We'll make more energy from the panels then it costs to create them, but we will get to a point where just reached a limit on how good the panels can be.
